name: Coquitos (Coconut Macaroons)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl.

If your paste is too thick to pipe with a large piping tip, then add the water, and keep adding one tbsp of water at a time until you get a consistency you can pipe. If your eggs are extra large, you may not need the extra water.
Pipe dollops on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake in a medium to hot oven for 30 minutes or until done.

culture.text: Coquito is a traditional Christmas drink that originated in Puerto Rico. The coconut-based alcoholic beverage is similar to eggnog, and is sometimes referred to as Puerto Rican eggnog. The mixed drink is made with Puerto Rican rum, coconut milk, cream of coconut, sweetened condensed milk, vanilla, nutmeg, clove, and cinnamon.
